summary_1line: Vasishtha explains creation and recites the Solar dynasty lineage to persuade Rama to uphold royal duty and return to Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Vasishtha stands before Rama in the forest, raising his hand as he solemnly recounts the ancient lineage of kings.
Queen Kalindi bows before the sage Chyavana in the Himalayan hermitage as he prophesies the birth of her son Sagara.
The newborn Sagara, radiant like Brahma, lies beside his mother after surviving the poison meant to destroy him.
